//: This repo is bash and compose. npm is a task runner for it, nothing more:
there are no dependencies and nothing is ever installed.
Run `npm run deploy`, never `sudo npm run deploy` - node lives in nvm,
which sudo strips from PATH; the sudo calls are inside tools/deploy.sh.
Never name a script install, prepare or postinstall - npm fires those
deploy installs the pms-update units and arms the timer only while
plexmediaserver is masked - the same signal pms-local's deploy uses.
start never passes --profile: profiled services are runbook steps.
stop keeps containers and config; nothing here runs `down -v`.
reclaim:audit shows what arr-reclaim.service would remove; it changes nothing.
name: pms-arr-setup
description: Containerized media stack for the pms home server (bash + docker compose; npm is only a task runner)

scripts.lint: command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || { echo 'shellcheck not installed (sudo apt install shellcheck)' >&2; exit 1; }; shellcheck -x tools/*.sh tools/lib/*.sh tests/*.sh && docker compose config -q
scripts.status: docker compose ps; echo; systemctl list-timers pms-update.timer --all --no-pager
